div.div: حَآءٌ The name of the letter ح, q. v.; as also حَا: (S and K and TA in باب الالف اللّينة:) it is called حا in a case of pause, and حَآءٌ when made a noun: and when it is not called a letter, [i. e. when one does not prefix to it the word حَرْف,] it is [properly] fem.: its dim. is حُيَيَّةٌ, meaning a ح written small, or indistinct: (Lth, TA ubi suprà:) and its pl. is أَحْوَآءٌ and أَحْيَآءٌ and حَاآتٌ. (TA ubi suprà.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
